contextBefore.narration: be silenced is terrifying. But to be re-recorded in the state's voice is the true death. By having nothing by retreating into
internal immigration like Sparrow or choosing the ultimate refusal like Zhuli, you prevent them from re-recording you.
You keep your silence and in that silence your true song, your true counterpoint survives.

beats.narration: You preserve the zero no matter the cost so that it can eventually become So as we close this out, I want to leave you with a final lingering
thought to mle over. Imagine if tomorrow your reality was inverted. Imagine if the music you hum in the shower, your Spotify
playlists, your family photographs, the very way you express your inner self were suddenly outlawed.
If the state demanded that you forget who you are and sing their song instead or face the consequences. What is the one fragment,
the one specific song or the one family story you would memorize to smuggle your soul into the future? What is your personal book of records?
